author: @redcke5155
text: Please stop hating Bahiyyih. Yes, the Huening Family is talented. HueningKai also deserved to debut, and we see that for his talent. Lea was an Idol before him, and they didn't put hate on him because of that. But, considering his talent, would it make any sense to put hate on him if the group Lea participated in was more famous? Honestly, do you guys think Mnet would really put someone in a group if they didn't have some talent? the public saw it too, and she wasn't very popular at first even though she was his sister. She grew in popularity as did Yujin who was also not so "high" in a Ranking even though she was already part of a group and Cheshire was trying to support her. So what would be the logic of the two of them growing up if they weren't good at something? have you actually watched Girls Planet 999, seen only a few pieces, or are you being influenced by things they say about her even though you don't even know her? If you just don't like her for no reason, it won't be worth it to keep hating her. I guess it doesn't feel very good when someone you don't like shows up, but you can't just hate the person and try to make them sad just for that. So just avoid seeing things about her if you don't like it and try to be happy with things you like, please. If you want her to leave the group, know that your hatred will not affect it, then give it up, because I also say this for your sakes because I know you can still regret and feel ashamed for doing this. Please just follow along and give love to the groups you like, and if you like Kep1er but don't like her, just stop trying to hurt her and show your love to other girls. If you are people who accept other opinions and change yours, you would like it As you follow the group without trying to see faults. Yes, several Girls Planet 999 trainees deserved to debut as well and might even debut in some group, but it's not Bahiyyih or any other member of Kep1er who stopped that. They deserved it too, and you can see that by looking at the entire reality show.

text:
1. SXT and KDY as visual and song centers. They did VERY well here. I wasn't expecting them to start with SXT though--call me pleasantly surprised.
2. Attention-grabbing, bias-wrecking HIKARU. Oh my god that lead-in to the second chorus, in the leather jacket was easily the moment that stood out to me the most. They need to use Hikaru more for SURE.
3. Very, VERY small missed opportunity to use the GP 999 #1 cell in the last bridge before the end, but going with Mashiro-SXT-KDY was a totally fine decision.
4. Yeongeun vocal yet AGAIN shines here. She does the last high note before the first chorus? Ala Jo Yuri? Whaaaatttt? XD
5. Best delivered line: "Vroom vroom vroom like a super sonic"

Every member did really really well! Personally Wa Da Da Da is 8.5/10 as a song for me, 9/10 as an MV. Extremely well done.

Yujin is my bias and the reason I watched Girls Planet 999 and I am honestly happy with the amount of screen time and lines she got in this MV. I feel like she has small parts throughout the whole song- she sings in the first verse, has the ‘wa da da’ adlibs, sings the chorus and has also has some time in the centre which not every member got. And just look at that smile at 0:25!

I see a lot of comments about the unfair line distribution but I feel like every member fulfilled their positions in the group. Chaehyun as the center and main vocal, Yeseo and Xiaoting as the visuals, Yujin, Youngeun and Mashiro as the lead dancers and vocals/all rounders, Dayeon and Hikaru as main and lead rappers and Bahiyyih as the sub vocalist. Every group has a sub position in the group to balance things out and unfortunately it was Bahiyyih in this MV but hopefully this rotates between the members in each comeback.

The only thing I would change would be to give one of Dayeon’s rap lines to Hikaru and Youngeun/Mashiro but other than that, I really think this is an adequate line and screen time distribution.

author: @yohan020
text:
I thoroughly enjoyed that debut. Such an energetic and pumped up entry into 2022 it’s honestly a nice vibe to start the year off with.
The mv was honestly pretty simple, it felt very choreography focused which is really okay to see for a debut, shows that they aren’t scared to dance, and a lot of the parts of the video where they would make formations (especially in trios) was super cool to look at.
Also, with only watching it once so far, the beginning was captivating with the bright and eye-catching screens / cgi; the pink bars behind them in one scene early on in that outdoor factory / industrial set was really cool to see. And gosh that bridge camerawork, like sheeeeeeeesh. Super super cool with the corresponding choreography.
Overall a really nice debut with a definite bop that’s catchy. From the teaser I knew I would love the vibe, it gave off Blackpink / Everglow hype level songs. They delivered, and the camerawork / choreography was giving me the work ethic of Itzy / JYP so I was definitely impressed, especially since they give off that “cute” aesthetic, but went hardcore for the debut. Can’t wait to listen to this again and the other songs!
Fighting Kep1er!!
From an ARMY/MOA/ENGENE 💜

author: @Valentineatelier
text:
OK IM ALREADY COMING UP WITH FAN THEORIES

The use of quantum leaping*(?)* by that i mean the girls teleporting to different spots + the transitions i think implies that there are more than 1 version of kepler- the dark kepler and lighter kepler, plus a more “neutral” kepler (the ones that were in the vintage house and where Hikaru has those cute space buns❤️)

In the teasers its shown that the girls are trying to get a signal out somewhere, possibly to another plane beyond their own. Since the keplers dressed in other outfits seem to be planets away, this could possibly alternate universes? Or possibly kepler from the past/future?
To me it seems like the kepler dressed in pink and the one in dark colors are communicating from different worlds wether they are aware of it or not. (Worlds could mean planet or timeline, I’m not sure yet)

Another important thing to mention is that boxed off room with a huge portal. Pink Kepler is seen in there, so i think maybe the box-ey room is like a rest stop between the different worlds and they’re on their way over to one of the alternate worlds?
(If you’re familiar with reality shifting and know what waiting rooms are, think of it like that)

It’s a bit confusing on which one is OUR kepler / “the real” kepler, but I’m assuming it’d be the one who is trying to contact the fans? So possibly the first kepler we see from the house. Xiaotings on YouTube has some theories mentioning the idea of an evil kepler and i believe it seeing how the kepler in dark outfits appear to be interacting with the kepler in pink.

I also find it interesting how “neutral” kepler’s outfits are a perfect mix of the “pretty” side of pink kepler and “punk” side of dark kepler. I think this could mean Neutral Kepler was the original group and they tried to travel beyond their home planet (girls’ planet if you will *laugh track*) , but somehow they found two separate versions of themselves, showing what path they could take in the future aka the pink and dark kepler. Maybe its an allegory to real life showing the group’s uncertainty for the future. Should they promote with cute concepts or badass/girl crush?

One last thing, i thought it was interesting how some girls in Dark kepler are wearing pure white- which was why i was avoiding saying “black clothing” compared to “dark clothing”
For example, Bahiyyih is in all white, she also has a solo shot in the mysterious portal room also. That could imply that her and some of the other dark girls are aware of the alternate keplers?

Edit: Bahi is the only one in pure white minus her shoes, all the other girls have at least one piece of black
